summary: Ran test suites across the gizmo monorepo and the gizmo-registry workspace, then configured vitest in gizmo-registry to fix Svelte/jsdom setup issues. The gizmo tests passed except for agent-server failures (Windows path containment in run-script, extension resource roots, pi-runtime config, and session repository), while gizmo-registry's first run failed due to missing test dependencies and Svelte parsing.
decisions: Installed @testing-library/svelte, jsdom, and @testing-library/jest-dom as devDependencies in gizmo-registry so Svelte component tests can run.
Added a vitest.config.ts in gizmo-registry that enables the svelte() plugin, aliases '@gizmo/unity/server' to its source entry, sets environment to 'jsdom', and wires up a setup file.
Added a vitest.setup.ts that registers @testing-library/jest-dom matchers and stubs ResizeObserver globally.
errors: gizmo apps/agent-server tests failed (17 tests across run-script, extension-resources, session-repository, pi-runtime-config); run-script failures were caused by 'Script must be inside the workspace' on Windows paths (build.ts, run.ts).
extension-resources tests failed because packageResourceRoots returned empty skills/prompts arrays instead of the expected conventional or pi-manifest-declared directories.
session-repository test failed comparing restored session list (workspacePath came back as 'C:\\projects\\tools' rather than '/projects/tools').
pi-runtime-config tests failed on import/auth re-import expectations and a permission-mode check on auth.json (0o777 mismatch).

gizmo-registry vitest run initially failed 9 suites: '@gizmo/unity/server' could not be resolved, '@testing-library/svelte' was missing, vite import-analysis could not parse .svelte files, and node rejected the '.svelte' extension for @lucide/svelte until the svelte plugin and jsdom env were configured.
